item.starboundmc.matter_manipulator.tool:
A relic from a distant universe.
Hold right-click to melt blocks with the mining beam (harder blocks take longer; speed upgrades accelerate, range upgrades widen)
Mining tier: 0 iron ore | 1 diamond & obsidian | 2 ancient debris
Wrong-tier blocks break but drop nothing
item.starboundmc.matter_manipulator_modu:
An upgrade component for the Matter Manipulator.
Levels 1/2/3 cost 1/2/4 modules.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.title: N.O.V.A.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.subtitle: SHIPBOARD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.notice: Local interaction prototype. Story and ship state are not connected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.welcome: Shipboard interface online. Select a diagnostic prompt to test streaming text and terminal controls.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.id: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. This prototype uses scripted local dialogue.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.pr: This cyan-white construct is a synthetic visual interface. Its eye brightness and projection stability indicate my current state.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.st: The terminal is operating in local prototype mode. Story progression and shared ship state remain disconnected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.incompa: This world uses a newer story-state format. Update the mod before operating this terminal.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.first_c: Shipboard systems are back online. Your vital signs are stable. It is good to be in contact with you again.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.n: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. I coordinate navigation, vessel operations, and onboard system monitoring.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.i: The ship encountered a high-intensity cosmic storm and was forced off its original course. Part of the navigation data was lost during the incident. I am still determining the exact cause.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.c: Our position is confirmed. Fortunately, we are currently in orbit around a habitable planet. Preliminary scans indicate a viable surface, with no immediate threats to life detected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.f: The propulsion systems are offline, and the ship cannot leave orbit under its own power. The teleporter remains operational; I recommend restoring the sublight engine first.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.landing: The teleporter is operating normally. Once you reach the surface, I will re-establish the communications link and continue analyzing the surrounding environment. For now, explore the surface and use the Matter Manipulator to gather basic resources.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.current: Current objective: use the ship teleporter to reach the planet surface. I will provide further environmental analysis and guidance after you arrive.
The initial surface expedition is complete. Continue gathering basic resources while I verify the sublight-engine repair plan.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.late_jo: Core systems are back online. I am compiling the ship's current status and the tasks available to you.
Sublight engine: damaged. In-system travel is unavailable.
Sublight engine: online. In-system travel is restored.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.status.hyperdriv: Hyperspace engine: damaged. Interstellar travel is unavailable.
Hyperspace engine: online. Interstellar travel is restored.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.status.mineral_s: Orbital mineral survey: awaiting surface resource data.
Orbital mineral survey: analyzing planetary strata.
Orbital mineral survey: complete; sparse diamond signatures detected in the deeper strata.
task.starboundmc.first_landing.title: First Landing
task.starboundmc.first_landing.objective: Use the ship teleporter to reach the planet surface.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.emerge: Warning: critical system failure detected. C▒ORE ST▓ATUS: #%/unreadable. Please reboot the core systems.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.locate: Communications remain unstable... locate the shipboard AI terminal and reboot the core systems.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.core_o: Core systems are back online. I am assessing the ship's overall status.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.first_: I have confirmed your arrival on the planet surface. The communications link is restored.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.matter: Explore the surrounding area and use the Matter Manipulator to gather basic resources. Hold right-click to activate the mining laser.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.wood_a: Good. You have acquired wood. It is a versatile basic resource; based on current data, your survival probability has increased by 17 percentage points.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.minera: Orbital scanners are online. Mineral survey in progress................
The preliminary scan is complete. Coal, copper, and iron are present in the upper strata; deeper layers also contain lapis lazuli, redstone, and sparse diamond deposits.

Diamond's crystalline structure may be suitable for replacing the damaged focusing crystal in the sublight engine's ignition array. I still need to verify the complete repair plan. Until then, continue gathering basic resources.
command.starboundmc.debug.engine.all_res: Debug: sublight engine and hyperdrive restored.
command.starboundmc.debug.engine.not_res: Engine restoration failed: reboot the core and complete First Landing first; the sublight engine must be online before the hyperdrive. The requested engine may also already be online.
command.starboundmc.debug.mineral_scan.r: Debug: the mineral-survey scene will replay in about 15 seconds.
command.starboundmc.debug.mineral_scan.u: The mineral survey cannot be replayed until core reboot and First Landing are complete.
